scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && py -3 -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python dev.py" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m ruff check . && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:q: node scripts/quiet.mjs backend\.venv\Scripts\python -m ruff check backend -q && node scripts/quiet.mjs npm --prefix frontend run lint --silent
scripts.check:web: node scripts/quiet.mjs npx --prefix frontend tsc --noEmit -p frontend
scripts.build:web: node scripts/quiet.mjs npm --prefix frontend run build --silent
